meta.title: The Whispering Vault
meta.premise: The abbey of Saint Corvin was abandoned in a single night. Kael has come for the sealed vault beneath it, and the abbot's study is the only room still lit.

entities.name: the abbot's study
entities.brief: A cramped room of ledgers and cold candle stubs; a loose flagstone hides something under the desk.

entities.name: the cloister
entities.brief: A frost-rimed colonnade around a dead garden; Brother Tomas sweeps it to no purpose.

entities.name: the bell tower
entities.brief: A cramped climb of rotten ladders above the nave, its bell long since stilled.

entities.name: the sealed vault
entities.brief: The undercroft chamber Kael came for, its door bearing a seal nobody living can read.

entities.name: Mara
entities.brief: The abbey's last scribe, cautious and tired, still cataloguing books nobody will read.

entities.name: Brother Tomas
entities.brief: A deaf old porter who sweeps the cloister and knows almost nothing about the vault.

entities.name: Elena
entities.brief: The vault's former archivist, hiding in the bell tower; she alone remembers the sealing rite.

entities.name: a bloated rat
entities.brief: It has grown fat on the dead garden and does not run from a lantern.

entities.name: the vault map
entities.brief: A creased chart of the undercroft, marking a stair the abbey's own plans deny.
